description: Format-preserving placeholder generation. input.salt is the STUBSMITH_MASK_SALT string (empty or absent means no key; key is its UTF-8 bytes truncated to 64 bytes, see expected.salt_key_hex). Values and outputs use a typed encoding ({type: str|int|float|bool|none, value|text}) so int vs float survives; float text is Python repr. email_domain null means default (stub.invalid).
